jobs.description: Important: This is a contract/part-time role: 10-20 hrs/week - rate $40-50/hr NOPE is an AI safety company with a unique goal; we do not concern ourselves with bio or cyber-risks or other Hollywood-ized alignment fantasies. We are concerned instead with the massive proliferation of relationships between humans and AI and how this affects our wellbeing and societal fabrics. Billions of conversations between people and AI are accumulating into relationships. This ranges children talking to toys, adults with AI companions, or elderly people engaging with healthcare assistants. We measure real conversations and relationships, and the trajectories of risks involved, and publish what we find, so platforms (and society) can decide when and how to act. We build ML models, track incidents, analyze new regulations, and run evaluations constantly on both raw LLMs and deployed AI. We believe you cannot foster safe and aligned AI without proprer governance and scrutiny into AI as it is truly deployed and productized. The eval space in AI is currently heavily oriented to raw LLM evals unfortuntely. We seek to change that. We seek to hold AI labs and products to account for the harms they produce. Our mission is malleable and always changing, and we search for people who seek to help define that. The Social Comms role : We are doing quite a lot but are very limited on social-and-community-driving capacity. The incidents and regulations we track, the whitepapers, plus our evaluations, are all lacking our commentary and voice. We want to increase our social media presence significantly and start to be a more active participant in the global conversation around AI safety and alignment. As our social-comms person you'd take artifacts and research we produce and weave them into a consistent, human presence on the prevalent social channels: deciding what gets posted, writing it, engaging with the researchers, journalists, builders and policymakers already wrestling with these questions. You're a pundit, optimist, skeptic, researcher and writer all rolled into one.Â The measure of your work would be whether the right people are actually engaging: researchers, builders, journalists, policymakers, and the ordinary users who sense something is off. jobs.title: Why do you want this new job
jobs.description: No matter which side of the table youâve sat during interviews, youâve probably heard this question: âWhy do you want this new job?â In the recent past, Iâve interviewed a few candidates and heard the following answers so far: Iâm not learning much on the current job after itâs been 2-4 years. Iâm looking for something that offers better work-life balance. Iâm not really looking for a job. The recruiters got in touch and I thought Iâd discuss. Iâm looking for more challenging work. All of the above are valid answers. I think thereâs another perfectly valid answer that candidates seldom mention probably due to the gravity of the interview room situation. Iâve interviewed over a hundred candidates across different companies and am yet to find anyone that mentions: I am not happy with my current salary and benefits compared to my skills Back to topic of answers. So, when someone answers that they are not learning new things on the job, obviously, youâd be curios to know why and how they have tried to change things. Unfortunately, most candidates simply mention that they are doing repeat work and thereâs not much to learn doing the same thing over and over again. This is where I start feeling a little uneasy. However, I understand that itâs a true statement. If youâre in a similar situation, hereâs some suggestion: read books, and write code based on what youâve read. Then, you can tell a much convincing story that, Iâve forced myself to learn new things and hereâs some proof, but I really want to apply the newly learned skills outside the scope of the âhello worldâ skills. About work-life balance, I totally hear you. And if your current job doesnât suit what you need out of your life, itâs a perfectly valid reason to look for new opportunities. However, make sure youâre able to clearly set the expectation with your potential employer about what work-life balance means for you. For example, if you canât work over 40 hours a week, or must work from home one-two days a week, itâs best to discuss this even before an interview starts to ensure youâre a good match with the employer. If you showed up at in interview just because a recruiter got in touch, Iâd say introspect first. Itâs possible that on our subconcious mind you have expectations that the potential of the new job offers you something that you donât get at the current job. So, instead of a passive asnwer that the you simply acted based on the recruiterâs invite, itâs much convincing to see if you can lay down one or two things that you expect from the new job that you donât get at the current job. About looking for more challenge, it sounds like a cliche unless you can share examples of work that is of challenging to you. May be you like the challenge of using more complicated algorithms, may be you like dealing with a lot of data, may be you like supporting production emergencies, but thereâs gotta be something that you can explicitly mention as challenging. It helps employers to understand if theyâre able to provide you with enough challenge on the job. Finally, if youâre looking for a new job because the current job isnât paying upto the level of your skills and contributions, make sure to communicate it clearly as well. With salaries and benefits, I find it much easier to work with people that know the actual $ figure thatâll make them happy instead of beating around the bush to create confusions all around. Just be confident and tell what makes you happy. If the employer can afford it, most likely theyâll want to get you onboard as a happy employee. If they canât afford it, theyâll do their best. The key here is to be explicit about what you want and be sure and confident about it. In a nutshell, when you walk into an interview itâs yours to lose. The potential employer is investing their time and resources and would rather have you hired than having to interview other candidates. A

jobs.title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer / SRE – Kubernetes & Hybrid Cloud (m/f/d)
jobs.description: Introduction At a glance Location & work model : Berlin, hybrid Tech stack: Kubernetes on our own servers, Harvester ( KubeVirt ), Argo CD/Flux, Prometheus/Grafana, Longhorn/Ceph Team: A growing SRE team – you report to our CTPO for now and to the Team Lead SRE we're hiring next; two system administrators in Pforzheim run the physical hardware Process: Intro call · take-home task (~2h) · 90-min tech interview with our developers · leadership conversation · meet the team Languages: Fluent English required; German is a plus, not a must Why this role is special Most SRE jobs today mean clicking around a managed cloud console. This one doesn't. We run our own hardware in Frankfurt and are building a modern private cloud platform on Kubernetes and Harvester – on-prem by default, with elastic burst into the public cloud and the option to go cloud-only later. You won't inherit a finished SRE practice: you'll help define it, side by side with our Berlin development teams – and you won't do it alone, a Team Lead SRE hire is coming next. SRE here is an enabling discipline: you build what our developers need to ship reliably, while two system administrators in Pforzheim run the physical hardware. And the impact is direct – our product discovery technology powers more than 2,000 European online shops (Intersport, SPAR, Douglas and more), handling billions of shopper queries a year. When product discovery is slow or down, our customers lose revenue in real time. Your first 90 days You get to know both products, join the on-call rotation with a buddy, and own your first reliability topic – SLOs for one product, alerting that actually helps at 3 a.m., or automating away a piece of toil. By day 90 you've shipped visible improvements and know where you want to take the platform next. Your mission Define and own SLOs, SLIs and error budgets; drive data-informed reliability decisions Lead incident response end-to-end: fast detection, clear communication, blameless postmortems – and reduce whole classes of incidents structurally, not case by case Eliminate toil through automation and GitOps; evolve our observability (metrics, logs, traces, alerting, runbooks) across two different stacks Help build our custom Kubernetes operator (CRDs) that makes stateful search clusters declarative, self-healing and safely upgradable – and roll out the auto-scaling (HPA/VPA, KEDA, cluster auto scaler) today's architecture makes hard Plan capacity, performance and cost across on-premises and cloud – including the large-catalogue and peak-season loads our merchants care about – and use AI tools wherever they measurably speed up diagnosis and operations Your profile Must-haves: Kubernetes in production – built, not just used : you've set up and maintained clusters on your own servers (e.g. kubeadm , RKE2, k3s) and know cluster lifecycle and upgrades – managed-only experience isn't enough for this role Lived SRE practice : SLOs, error budgets, incident management, on-call Hands-on experience with GitOps or comparable infrastructure/deployment automation – experience with Argo CD or Flux is a strong plus Solid observability skills – metrics, logs, traces, alerting that people trust A strong automation instinct – you'd rather fix a problem's cause than repeat its workaround A collaborative, enabling mindset – you see SRE as a service to our developers: you ask what they need, discuss trade-offs openly, and don't fall in love with your own solution Nice-to-haves (genuinely optional – we'll teach you the rest): Harvester, KubeVirt , vSphere/ ESXi , OpenStack or similar virtualization/HCI platforms Container storage (Longhorn, Ceph) and datacenter networking (load balancing, ingress, VLAN) Auto-scaling (HPA, VPA, KEDA, cluster auto scaler ) and capacity/cost planning Experience building Kubernetes operators/CRDs German language skills Certifications (CKA, CKS) are welcome but no substitute for hands-on experience – in the tech interview we'll ask about what you've act

jobs.title: Full Stack Product Developer (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Aufgaben Du willst Technologie gestalten, die direkt etwas bewegt? Bei Table.Briefings entwickeln wir digitale Produkte für ein wachsendes Medienunternehmen. Unsere Software hilft dabei, Prozesse effizienter zu machen, neue Geschäftsmodelle zu ermöglichen und unseren Redaktionen den Rücken freizuhalten – damit sie sich auf das konzentrieren können, was sie am besten können: hochwertigen Journalismus! Als dritter interner Entwickler bzw. dritte interne Entwicklerin übernimmst du eine zentrale Rolle in unserem Tech-Team. Du arbeitest an der gesamten Entwicklungskette: von der ersten Idee über Konzeption und Umsetzung bis zu Deployment, Betrieb und Weiterentwicklung. Dabei geht es nicht nur darum, Features zu programmieren. Du hilfst uns, die richtigen Probleme zu erkennen, Anforderungen zu schärfen und Lösungen zu entwickeln, die für unser Business, unsere Nutzerinnen und Nutzer und unsere Redaktionen wirklich einen Unterschied machen. Deine Aufgaben Du konzipierst, entwickelst und betreust unsere Webanwendungen, APIs und Apps. Du arbeitest an unseren Statamic -basierten Plattformen und entwickelst unser CMS weiter. Du entwickelst neue Funktionen mit unserem bestehenden Tech-Stack und verbesserst bestehende Lösungen kontinuierlich. Du beschäftigst dich mit dem Einsatz und der Optimierung von Large Language Models und Coding Agents – zur Automatisierung interner Prozesse und für neue Produktfeatures. Du entwickelst und integrierst RESTful APIs, zum Beispiel zur Anbindung von Systemen wie ActiveCampaign . Du wirkst bei der Konfiguration, Wartung und Absicherung unserer Linux-Server und Deployment -Prozesse mit. Du übersetzt Anforderungen aus unterschiedlichen Bereichen in klare technische Lösungen. Du bringst Struktur in komplexe oder noch nicht vollständig definierte Aufgaben und sorgst dafür, dass aus Ideen umsetzbare Produkte werden. Du arbeitest eng mit Stakeholdern, Produktverantwortlichen, Redaktion und Geschäftsführung zusammen. Unser Tech-Stack - Wir arbeiten unter anderem mit: PHP und Laravel Statamic PostgreSQL Livewire HTML, CSS und JavaScript RESTful APIs Linux-Servern und modernen Deployment -Prozessen Large Language Models und Coding Agents Du musst unseren Tech-Stack nicht bereits vollständig beherrschen – wichtiger sind uns dein technisches Verständnis, deine Kommunikationsstärke und deine Fähigkeit, komplexe Anforderungen schnell in gute Lösungen zu übersetzen. Du solltest aber Lust haben, mit unseren Technologien zu arbeiten und dich schnell in neue Systeme und Themen einzuarbeiten. Wir suchen keine Person, die jedes Tool schon einmal eingesetzt hat, sondern jemanden, der gute technische Entscheidungen trifft, Zusammenhänge versteht und Verantwortung übernimmt. Qualifikation Du hast fundierte Erfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung und beherrschst mindestens eine relevante Programmiersprache sicher. Du hast idealerweise Erfahrung mit Webanwendungen, APIs und Datenbanken. Du interessierst dich für unseren Tech-Stack und hast Lust, dich in Laravel , Statamic , PostgreSQL und Livewire einzuarbeiten oder darin weiterzuentwickeln. Du verstehst, wie man LLMs und Coding Agents sinnvoll und verantwortungsvoll in der Softwareentwicklung einsetzt – oder möchtest es lernen. Du kennst dich mit Linux-Servern, Deployment und grundlegenden Fragen der IT-Sicherheit aus oder bist bereit, dich in diese Themen einzuarbeiten. Du kannst komplexe Probleme schnell erfassen, priorisieren und in konkrete nächste Schritte übersetzen. Du kommunizierst klar und gerne – auch mit Menschen, die nicht technisch arbeiten. Du kannst unterschiedliche Anforderungen und Perspektiven zusammenbringen und sicher mit Stakeholdern umgehen. Du arbeitest selbstständig, zuverlässig und lösungsorientiert. Du behältst auch dann den Überblick, wenn Anforderungen sich verändern, Informationen zunächst unvollständig sind oder mehrere Themen gleichzeitig auf dem Tisch liegen. Du hast Freude daran, in solchen Situationen Ruhe, Struktur und Verbindlichkeit zu schaffen

jobs.title: Ausbildung zum*r Fachinformatiker*in Systemintegration 2027
jobs.description: Du hast Spaß daran, anderen das Arbeiten mit IT leicht zu machen – und willst verstehen, was im Hintergrund passiert, wenn Laptop, Account, Software und Rechte sauber zusammenspielen? Du möchtest lernen, wie wir unsere Kolleg*innen im Alltag unterstützen: von „Mein Setup funktioniert nicht“ über „Welche Software brauche ich?“ bis hin zu Onboarding, Geräteausgabe und Zugriffsrechten? Bei uns lernst Du, wie professionelle Office-IT arbeitet: strukturiert, serviceorientiert und mit modernen Tools – damit alle Teams optimal arbeiten können. Im Rahmen der Ausbildung zum/zur Fachinformatiker*in Systemintegration baust Du Dir das Fundament für Deine Zukunft in der Office-IT / IT-Support / Workplace-Administration auf. Du lernst, Arbeitsplätze zu planen und bereitzustellen, Hardware zu konfigurieren und zu betreuen, Software zu paketieren/auszurollen und Lizenzen zu verwalten. Außerdem bekommst Du Einblicke in User- und Access-Management, IT-Sicherheit im Arbeitsalltag, Standardisierung, Dokumentation sowie in den Umgang mit Ticketsystemen und Support-Prozessen (1st & 2nd Level). Gemeinsam sorgen wir dafür, dass unsere Kolleg*innen zuverlässig, sicher und effizient arbeiten können. Dein Blick über den Tellerrand - System Administration: Ein fester Teil Deiner Ausbildung findet in unserer System Administration statt. Dort lernst Du die Technik kennen, die hinter unseren Spielen läuft: Wie tausende Linux-Server automatisiert verwaltet werden, wie Netzwerke, Monitoring und Backups aufgebaut sind und wie man mit Skripting wiederkehrende Aufgaben abschafft. Du siehst also nicht nur den Arbeitsplatz Deiner Kolleg*innen, sondern auch die Infrastruktur dahinter – und verstehst am Ende, wie beides zusammenhängt. Haben wir Dein Interesse geweckt? Bewirb Dich jetzt für den Ausbildungsbeginn im August 2027 . Dich erwartet aktive Unterstützung durch ein engagiertes Team, moderne Arbeitsbedingungen und ein Umfeld, in dem Zusammenarbeit und Servicegedanke wirklich zählen.  Dein Skillset Klasse Leistung.  Du wirst Dein Abitur oder Deine Fachhochschulreife mit guten Noten absolvieren – besonders in NAT, Englisch und idealerweise auch Informatik. Erste Praxis. Erste praktische Erfahrungen mit einem Mac oder auch mit dem Aufsetzen eines Netzwerks bringst Du bereits mit. Zukunftsgestalter*in. Du siehst in der Künstlichen Intelligenz die Chance, die Zukunft unserer Spiele mitzugestalten und freust dich, Deine Begeisterung und ersten KI-Erfahrungen in realen Projekten anzuwenden. Deutschkenntnisse. Für eine erfolgreiche Teilnahme an unserem Ausbildungsprogramm verfügst Du mindestens über ein B2-Niveau in Deutsch, da der Berufsschulunterricht ausschließlich in deutscher Sprache stattfindet. Hands-on. Du packst gern an, probierst aus und bleibst dran, bis es läuft. Eigeninitiative . Du hast kein Problem auf Leute zuzugehen und Freude daran das technische Problem hinter der menschlichen Beschreibung zu erkennen. Unsere Unternehmenssprache ist Englisch. Du freust Dich darauf, Deine sehr guten Englischkenntnisse täglich in Wort und Schrift anzuwenden. Deine Power-Ups Ein Team  von Spezialist*innen. Werde Teil eines großartigen, internationalen Teams von Spezialist*innen und arbeite und lerne bei einem der führenden Spieleentwickler und Publisher in Deutschland. Optimales Lernumfeld. Wir bieten dir ein äußerst interessantes technisches Umfeld und modernste Arbeitsbedingungen. Überdurchschnittliche Vergütung. Finanzielle Unabhängigkeit ermöglichen wir Dir mit unserer überdurchschnittlichen Ausbildungsvergütung: 1.270 EUR brutto im 1. Lehrjahr, 1.500 EUR brutto im 2. Lehrjahr, 1.715 EUR brutto im 3. Lehrjahr. Weiterentwicklung. jobs.title: Fullstack Entwickler (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt einen engagierten Fullstack Entwickler (m/w/d) am Standort München oder hybrid . Deine Aufgaben Entwicklung von Webapplikationen im Full-Stack-Bereich. Design und Implementierung von APIs (REST/GraphQL). Mitarbeit an Architekturentscheidungen und technischer Konzeption. Arbeit in agilen Teams (Scrum/Kanban) mit enger Zusammenarbeit zu Product Ownern, Design und DevOps. Integration von Cloud-Services (AWS, Azure, GCP) und DevOps-Tooling. Dein Profil Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Frontend-Entwicklung mit modernen Frameworks wie React, Angular oder Vue . Sehr gute Kenntnisse in der Backend-Entwicklung , z. B. mit Node.js (Express/NestJS), Python (Django/FastAPI) oder Java (Spring Boot) . Erfahrung mit relationale (PostgreSQL, MySQL) oder NoSQL-Datenbanken (MongoDB, Redis) . Kenntnisse in TypeScript oder JavaScript (Python/Java als Plus). Grundverständnis von Cloud- und DevOps-Umgebungen (Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD). Begeisterung für Clean Code, Testing und moderne Entwicklungspraktiken. Sprachniveau: Deutsch C1, Englisch B2 Was wir dir bieten Betriebliche Altersvorsorge zur Absicherung deiner Zukunft. Flexibles Mobilitätskonzept – wähle z. B. zwischen Tankgutschein, Deutschlandticket oder Rollernutzung. Hybrides Arbeiten Company Days für Wissensaustausch, Netzwerkpflege und Innovation. Regelmäßige Team-Events zum gemeinsamen Feiern und Austauschen. Persönlicher Buddy während deiner gesamten Einarbeitung – für Fragen, Orientierung und Vernetzung. Individuell abgestimmter Fortbildungs- und Entwicklungsplan für deine fachliche und persönliche Weiterentwicklung. 30 Urlaubstage und eine ausgeglichene Work-Life-Balance. Kaffee, Wasser, Softdrinks und natürlich auch ein Feierabendbier gehen auf uns! Über uns Als Teil der niederländischen ICT Group gestalten wir mit ICT Digital Solutions aktiv die digitale Transformation unserer Kunden – mit Leidenschaft für Technologie und Innovation. jobs.title: Senior Media Strategist
jobs.description: The role Execute game-changing fundraising strategies that tie engagement to the bottom line, utilising a diverse paid media mix to do so. As a Senior Media Strategist, you'll lead the execution of digital advertising campaigns across clients, with a particular focus on UK and global non-profits.  This may be the right role for you if you're someone who is equally strategic, creative, and analytical. Switching seamlessly from a client presentation, to writing an insightful analysis of campaign performance, and rolling up your sleeves to launch new creative are no big deal for you. You're used to spending most of your day speaking in acronyms — terms like CPA, ROAS, DSP and CTV are major parts of your vocabulary — and you know how to explain them to clients and teammates.  You will use your depth of paid media experience to inform your work but also tap into your digital curiosity and passion for innovation to bring new ideas and thinking to the team. The company Blue State is a purpose-driven agency. We partner with leading causes, brands, and campaigns and create real change. From AARP and Doctors Without Borders to Amnesty International and Oxfam, we transform how brands and causes raise money, influence policy, build platforms, and grow communities of supporters. Led by the most creative and analytical minds from the political, nonprofit, and brand worlds, Blue State is an independent agency in the US and London. A day in the life Build, manage, and optimize media campaigns across multiple platforms . You will have strong experience in paid social and paid search channels, and a relative understanding of programmatic DSPs.  Translate clients' strategic visions into media objectives and KPIs to accomplish a wide range of client objectives including direct response (lead gen and fundraising), awareness, persuasion, and advocacy. Analyze ongoing and historical performance data to identify opportunities for improvement, make strategic recommendations, and generate reporting and insights to drive optimization. Have a strong POV on measurement, attribution, and conversion tracking, and apply that knowledge to strategic recommendations and ongoing campaign management. Participate in (and frequently lead) client-facing interactions — you'll be the subject-matter expert for the platforms you manage. Work collaboratively with other internal or external teams, including media planners, strategists, account directors, designers, and analysts, to produce campaigns, creative ideas, audience and target recommendations, and experimental designs. Be an internal and external thought leader and help keep us up to date with the latest digital media trends by maintaining relationships with media partners, and engaging in media R&D projects, writing blog posts, and participating on panels The team As part of the Media team, you'll work closely with a cross-disciplinary group of Blue State employees on various projects. London is a small and close-knit team, where everyone has an opportunity to shape new approaches, grow and learn from their colleagues, and take advantage of a personal development fund to stretch their skills even further. You'll have the opportunity to work with some of the most inspiring charities, ambitious brands and passionate advocacy and social change campaigns. What we offer Unlimited time off (inclusive of sick, personal and vacation days) $1,000 annual in professional development funds (local equivalent) Fully subsidised health and dental insurance for employees (subject to tax) Generous pension match via salary sacrifice  Generous paid holiday schedule  Parental leave policy for up to 32.5 week of coverage at full pay, inclusive of all genders and supporting a range of family structures Group Income Protection (GIP) Group Life Assurance (GLA) Optional holiday travel insurance Pre-tax season ticket loans Cycle to work (up to £2000) Remote work flexibility We approach in-office working with a

jobs.title: Backend Engineer, Home Page & Merchandising Platform
jobs.description: Our Global Structure Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team. Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation and growth drive everything we do. Our Engineering teams tackle complex technical challenges across a global, three-sided marketplace, building and scaling systems that serve millions of customers, riders and partners every day. From real-time logistics to resilient infrastructure and marketplace optimisation, we design, build and operate technology that powers Deliveroo's growth at scale. We're looking for a Software Engineer to join our London team. In this role, you'll help us build and maintain high-performance systems that power our hyper-local marketplace, ensuring a seamless experience for millions of users. This role is based in our London office with a hybrid setup, typically 3 days in the office. Get to know our Engineering team — what drives us, how we work, and what you can expect. What You'll Be Doing You'll be joining a multi-disciplinary engineering team focused on technical execution and collaboration. As a Software Engineer at Deliveroo, your individual work contributes to achieving goals across your team, simplifying the maintenance of production systems while ensuring operational readiness and health. Here's what your day-to-day might look like: Design and scale backend services for our real-time marketplace using languages such as Go, Ruby, or Python. Improve code structure and architecture by participating in deep technical discussions and reviewing code across your team's remit. jobs.title: Director, GTM & Revenue Operations
jobs.description: THE CARWOW GROUP Carwow Group is driven by a passion for getting people into cars. But not just any car, the right car. That’s why we are building the go-to destination for car-changing, whether you are looking to buy, sell or lease. Designed to reach drivers everywhere with our trail-blazing portfolio of personality rich automotive brands; Carwow, Auto Express, evo, Driving Electric and Car Buyer. What started as a simple reviews site, is now one of the largest online car-changing destinations in Europe. Last year alone we grew over 50% with nearly £3bn worth of cars bought on site, while £1.8bn of cars were listed for sale through our Sell My Car service. Over 10m customers have used Carwow to help them buy and sell cars since its inception. In 2024 we went big and acquired Autovia, doubling our audience overnight. Together we now have one of the biggest YouTube channels in the world with over 1.1 billion annual views, sell 1.2 million print copies of our magazines and have an annual web content reach over 350million. WHY JOIN US? We are winners of the prestigious Culture 100 award that recognises the most loved and happiest tech companies to work for! We have just raised $52m in funding led by global venture capital firm Bessemer Venture Partners (an early backer of LinkedIn and Shopify) to accelerate our growth plans! As pioneers, we’re always driving for new territory and positive change, so our work as a group is never done. Where others see difficulty, it’s our responsibility to see possibility – building new experiences, launching new titles and listening to drivers. Being a part of Carwow Group means championing drivers and the automotive industry, acting as a disrupter and never being afraid to fail (but learning fast when we do!). Our team of 600 employees across the UK, Germany, Spain and Portugal are revolutionising car-changing and we are fast expanding our mission across every single brand and country we operate in, so jump in! THE ROLE This is a director role running the operating engine behind our commercial teams. Carwow sells cars in two ways: Sell My Car, where drivers sell their car to dealers, and Get Your Car, where they buy or lease their next one. As Director, GTM & Revenue Operations you own the operating model those commercial teams run on: the go-to-market process, the enablement and quality that get people productive, the systems they work in (Salesforce and the wider commercial tech stack), the analytics that forecast the commercial number, and the programme management that lands cross-functional change. The function covers five areas: GTM Operations, Sales Enablement, Tooling & Platform, Rev-Ops Analytics and Program Management. You report to the VP, Marketplace Operations and sit close to both the numbers and the commercial teams you serve. You make the commercial motion work; the commercial teams own the selling and the relationships. This is a builder's role as much as a running one. jobs.description: Frontline work keeps the world running. Restaurants, hospitals, schools, nurseries, airlines, stores, emergency services. Together they employ 80% of the global workforce, over 3 billion people, and they're among the hardest businesses anywhere to run. By-the-minute scheduling, HR and payroll make them far more operationally complex than the average office, yet just 1% of venture funding has ever gone to software built for them. Rising costs, wage increases, labour shortages and tighter regulation have made fixing that urgent. Sona is the AI-native workforce management platform for frontline organisations, with agents that match staffing to real demand and take the admin load off managers. That's a $500bn+ market the software industry has mostly walked past. We've raised over $100M from N47, Felicis, Gradient and Northzone, signed more than 100 enterprise customers across the UK and US, and opened offices in London, New York, Austin and Lisbon. About the Role As a Payroll Implementation Manager at Sona, you'll take end-to-end ownership of onboarding customers onto our payroll platform, from initial discovery and system configuration through to parallel runs, training, and go-live. You'll work hands-on with the software itself, not just alongside it, partnering closely with the wider implementation team, product engineers, and payroll bureau colleagues to get every customer live cleanly. Attention to detail and end-to-end ownership matter more here than in most roles, and you'll need to be comfortable double-checking your own work and speaking up early when something doesn't look right. This role sits within a growing customer function that's still finding its shape. You'll have direct influence over how Sona's payroll implementation process and product evolve, with a level of access to the product team that's unusual for an implementer. It's a startup pace: no bureaucracy, high-caliber colleagues, and fast-moving development, so you'll need to be comfortable operating without everything being fully defined. And beyond. ⭐️ The Senior Revenue Operations job Our Business Strategy & Operations team runs the most critical, strategic, and data-driven projects at Alan. It sits at the intersection of Sales, Product, and Finance, and covers four core areas: sales strategy and planning, sales effectiveness, sales enablement, and business segment leadership. You'll be joining the Sales Effectiveness team , whose mission is to make our sales organization run at its best across France, Belgium, Spain, and Canada. This team is a key lever on one of the company's most watched metrics: our customer acquisition cost. Why is this role interesting? High-impact scope : You'll work across the full sales organization, from Account Executives to BDRs, Account Management, and Customer Success Managers. Real ownership : You'll own initiatives end to end, from strategy and design to execution and adoption, not just delivery. Builder's playground : You'll have access to a modern stack, combining low-code tools, AI (Dust, Claude), Salesforce, and SQL, to ship things fast and at scale. Tangible results : Recent examples from our roadmap include fully automating slide deck generation for Sales (saving 1,000+ hours per year) and building an AI-powered outbound machine reaching a 15% discovery rate. What will you do with us? You'll own effectiveness initiatives end to end, setting the roadmap, designing the solution, building it, driving execution, and managing change across the organization. You'll spend meaningful time in the field to spot gaps in our sales process, then design smarter workflows by eliminating steps and increasing automation. You'll evaluate new tools and technologies, run tests, and roll out what works. You'll mostly work with low-code tools (like Zapier or n8n), AI, Salesforce, SQL via Metabase, and whatever else the job calls for. Enablement is a key part of the role: you'll shadow, train, measure adoption, and iterate until change sticks. ⭐ Is it you we're looking for? You'll be a great fit for the Revenue Operations team at Alan if you: Have at least 5 years of experience in RevOps / Sales Ops / Sales Effectiveness , several of them spent hands-on building the sales machine. You own initiatives end-to-end (scope, design, build, measure); Demonstrate strong ownership and project management skills, and are comfortable running initiatives; Have a builder mindset and love being hands-on; Are confident with change management , including shadowing, training, measuring adoption, and iterating; Can write and own SQL queries yourself (joins, basic data modeling), not just read them. Have proven experience with low-code tools and integrations (e.g. Clay, Make, Zapier, or equivalent) to build scalable workflows Have configured Salesforce yourself (objects, fields, flows) and can say what you personally built vs. what an integrator or another team did.

Go-to-Market strategy: You’ll work both on renewal (account management) and expansion strategy (business development). P&L ownership & Resources allocation: You’ll own the return on investment of your segment and are in charge of building the case for internal resources allocation based on your P&L. Product trade-off: You’ll work together with product teams in order for us to build the best product based on market insights. We are currently hiring for new segments: It gathers several, high potential sub-segments where everything is to be built. jobs.title: Ingénieur.e : Évaluation de la susceptibilité à l’injection de fautes des nouvelles mémoires non volatiles – CDD 12 mois
jobs.description: Rejoindre Mines Saint-Étienne , c’est s’engager dans une institution où la science et l’innovation bâtissent un avenir plus durable. Une école d’excellence où chacun a l’opportunité de révéler son plein potentiel et de contribuer à relever les défis de demain. Classée parmi les meilleures écoles d’ingénieurs en France et reconnue mondialement, notre école, membre de l’Institut Mines-Télécom, forme les talents de demain tout en contribuant activement à relever les grands défis industriels, numériques et environnementaux. Avec nous, vous intégrez une communauté de 500 collaborateurs, 2500 étudiants, et participez à un projet ambitieux : conjuguer excellence académique, recherche d’avant-garde et impact sociétal positif.   L’Institut Mines-Télécom fédère les grandes écoles françaises autour des défis industriels majeurs, numériques, énergétiques et écologiques. Avec ses 8 Grandes Écoles publiques et 2 écoles filiales, il est le premier institut public dédié aux ingénieurs et managers. Ensemble, nous imaginons et construisons un avenir durable, en formant les acteurs qui façonneront les transitions de demain. 🎯 Ce que nous attendons de vous En tant qu’Ingénieur.e, vous êtes au cœur de nos missions en recherche, formation, et innovation ; affecté au Centre Microélectronique de Provence. Au sein de ce centre vous conjuguez passion scientifique et intérêt pour la recherche appliquée. Le département Systèmes et Architectures Sécurisés (SAS), du Centre Microélectronique de Provence (CMP), étudie la sécurité des composants électroniques et des données qu’ils contiennent (tels que des clefs de cryptographie, des logiciels, des blocs de propriété intellectuelle, des données en mémoires, etc.) vis-à-vis de manipulations frauduleuses couramment appelées “attaques” matérielles. Les enseignants-chercheurs du département SAS contribuent au développement de protections matérielles, logicielles, et cryptographiques contre ces attaques, et plus largement à la proposition de solutions de sécurité pour les objets mobiles. Le département SAS est associé au CEA Leti dans une équipe commune, l’EC SAS, comprenant actuellement 32 personnes.   Le recrutement d’un.e Ingénieur.e de recherche en Sécurité Matérielle s’inscrit dans le cadre du projet SecMemPCM financé par la Région Sud. Votre mission est une mission de recherche sur le sujet de la susceptibilité à l’injection de fautes des nouvelles mémoires non volatiles.  ·         Vous assurez un travail de recherche sur la susceptibilité des nouvelles mémoires non volatiles émergentes (eNVM) aux attaques matérielles, et plus particulièrement aux attaques par injection de fautes. ·         Vous menez des essais expérimentaux de caractérisation du comportement de divers types de eNVM face aux attaques par injection de fautes. Vous analysez les résultats afin de comprendre et modéliser les mécanismes associés. ·         Vous rendez compte des activités et des résultats qui relèvent des missions dont vous aurez la charge. Votre capacité à travailler en mode projet et à conduire un travail de recherche sera essentielle pour réussir.   🔍 Ce que nous recherchons Vous êtes titulaire d’un Diplôme Bac + 5 ou équivalent, ou d’une thèse. Vous avez des compétences scientifiques en Microélectronique et/ou en sécurité matérielle. Et idéalement : ·      Avec une expérience dans le domaine de la sécurité matérielle et des techniques d’injection de fautes. ·      Junior accepté : Oui ·      Une maîtrise de l’anglais (niveau C1).   Vos atouts supplémentaires : •           Vous êtes titulaire d’une thèse en microélectronique et/ou sécurité matérielle. •           Vous possédez

jobs.description: About Quandela: Quandela is a European deeptech company building modular, scalable and energy-efficient spin-photonic quantum computers. We develop the full quantum computing stack, from semiconductor quantum emitters and photonic processors to control systems, software and applications. Our platforms are available through the cloud and as on-premises systems. Our ambition is to build fault-tolerant quantum computers capable of solving problems beyond the reach of classical computation. The role: We are looking for an AI Scientist to join Quandela’s AI and Quantum Machine Learning team in Massy (near Paris) You will develop and evaluate machine-learning approaches for quantum computing, covering both: AI for quantum systems , including calibration, control, decoding for quantum error correction; quantum and hybrid machine learning , including rigorous comparisons with state-of-the-art classical methods, using MerLin, Quandela's framework for quantum machine learning. This role therefore offers significant ownership and the opportunity to help shape and grow the team over time. What You'll Do: Design, implement and train machine-learning and quantum machine-learning models. Develop AI methods to improve the calibration, control and performance of quantum systems. Benchmark classical, quantum and hybrid methods using meaningful baselines and evaluation metrics. Contribute actively to the development of the MerLin framework. Contribute to publications and collaborations with academic partners, including research ecosystem. Present your work internally and at scientific conferences and technical events. Help define Quandela’s future AI research directions and mentor junior researchers as the team grows. Requirements What we are looking for: We are looking for an AI scientist, or an experienced industry practitioner with an equivalent background, who is eager to apply state-of-the-art classical machine-learning methods to scientific and engineering challenges in quantum computing. The role is primarily focused on using AI to improve quantum technologies, while also providing opportunities to develop and investigate quantum and hybrid machine-learning models. PhD + 3 years of experience or equivalent industrial R&D experience in machine learning. Strong foundations in modern machine learning, experimental methodology and model evaluation. Excellent scientific programming skills, particularly in Python and common machine-learning frameworks. Experience taking research ideas from initial exploration to robust implementation. Interest in working on both longer term research and concrete product problems. Strong communication skills and the ability to work autonomously within a focused, multidisciplinary team. Professional fluency in English. Bonus Points Previous experience applying AI to physical systems, scientific computing, hardware control or experimental data. Knowledge of quantum computing, quantum machine learning or photonic quantum technologies. Experience mentoring junior researchers or helping define technical research directions. Aisance dans les environnements Linux. Expérience des tests de performance réseau, de l'observabilité et des systèmes de supervision. Goût prononcé pour la compréhension du comportement des systèmes dans des environnements réels. Capacité à intervenir aussi bien sur les aspects logiciels, réseaux que matériels. Approche de résolution de problèmes basée sur les données. Capacité à évoluer dans une organisation d'ingénierie en forte croissance et très collaborative. The Director will be responsible for ensuring program currency and curriculum quality, faculty hiring and performance, and achieving student outcomes within the International Relations and Diplomacy discipline. In addition, the Director will provide Academic Leadership at the Paris Campus for all academic programs. The role encompasses the oversight of program design, curriculum development, course content, syllabi, course delivery, assessment and continuous improvement processes, ensuring compliance with U.S. accreditation standards, local regulatory requirements, and dual-degree and articulation agreements with various partners. The Director will work closely with academic leaders across campuses to recruit, evaluate, and support faculty teaching International Relations and Diplomacy courses, ensuring consistency in academic standards and learning outcomes throughout the institution. The director will also work with academic team, student experience and data team to monitor key performance indicators and help design interventions to ensure achieving student outcomes set by the university. In collaboration with Associate Deans, Directors of other academic areas, and the Paris Campus Director, the Director of International Relations and Diplomacy Programs will provide academic leadership for the Paris Campus and oversee faculty hiring and management, course allocations and academic operation. The successful candidate will work closely with faculty, staff, and other university stakeholders to foster student engagement, academic success, preparation for employment and career success, and deliver a transformative, student-centered educational experience aligned with Schiller’s experiential and challenge-based learning model. jobs.description: Über uns Wir sehen die Halbleiterindustrie als ein Universum der Möglichkeiten. Wir sehen Chancen. jobs.title: Accounting Manager (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Verantwortung übernehmen. Accounting weiterdenken. Du möchtest nicht nur sicherstellen, dass die Buchhaltung zuverlässig läuft, sondern auch aktiv daran mitwirken, wie sie künftig noch effizienter gestaltet werden kann? Wir sind ein wachsendes Unternehmen im ambulanten Gesundheitsbereich. In den vergangenen Jahren haben wir unsere kaufmännischen Prozesse bereits deutlich digitalisiert, neue Systeme eingeführt und zahlreiche Abläufe optimiert. Und wir sind noch lange nicht am Ziel. Unser Unternehmen wächst kontinuierlich – und mit ihm die Anforderungen an unsere Buchhaltung. Unser Ziel : Prozesse so aufzustellen, dass neue Gesellschaften und steigende Umsätze nicht automatisch zu einem proportionalen Anstieg des manuellen Aufwands führen. Dafür suchen wir jemanden, der Accounting fachlich sicher beherrscht und zugleich den Blick nach vorne richtet. Jemanden, der Verantwortung übernimmt, Prozesse hinterfragt und gemeinsam mit uns an Lösungen arbeitet, die mit unserem Wachstum Schritt halten. Aufgaben Was du bei uns verantwortest Du übernimmst die Verantwortung für das Accounting mehrerer Gesellschaften und sorgst dafür, dass die Buchhaltung im Tagesgeschäft sauber läuft. Du verantwortest Monatsabschlüsse und UStVA sowie gemeinsam mit unseren Steuerberatern die Vorbereitung der Jahresabschlüsse. Auch unser Forderungsmanagement gehört zu deinem Verantwortungsbereich. Du führst unser zweiköpfiges Accounting-Team und entwickelst die Zusammenarbeit und Aufgabenverteilung im Team weiter. Du entwickelst unsere Accounting-Prozesse kontinuierlich weiter und nutzt Digitalisierung und Automatisierung dort, wo sie Abläufe einfacher, schneller und verlässlicher machen. Du entwickelst unsere Finance-Tools, digitalen Workflows und Schnittstellen weiter und sorgst dafür, dass unsere Prozesse mit dem Unternehmen mitwachsen können. Du arbeitest eng mit der Geschäftsführung zusammen und bist Ansprechpartner für unsere Steuerberater und die relevanten internen Bereiche. Qualifikation Was du mitbringst Du bist im Accounting fachlich zu Hause und hast mehrere Jahre relevante Berufserfahrung. Monatsabschlüsse, Kontenabstimmungen, Umsatzsteuer und die Vorbereitung von Jahresabschlüssen sind für dich vertraute Themen. Idealerweise bist du Bilanzbuchhalter/in, Steuerfachwirt/in oder bringst eine vergleichbare Qualifikation mit. Mit DATEV arbeitest du sicher; Erfahrung mit DATEV Unternehmen online ist von Vorteil. Erste Führungserfahrung ist gut, aber kein Muss. Wichtig ist uns, dass du gerne Verantwortung für ein Team übernimmst. Du interessierst dich für Digitalisierung und Automatisierung und probierst gerne aus, wie sich Abläufe einfacher und besser gestalten lassen. Wenn ein Prozess jeden Monat wieder manuell ausgeführt wird, fragst du dich automatisch: Warum eigentlich? Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift. Was dich bei uns erwartet Du übernimmst vom ersten Tag an Verantwortung für einen wichtigen Bereich unseres Unternehmens und ein bestehendes Team. Dabei startest du nicht bei null. In den vergangenen Jahren haben wir bereits viel verändert und digitalisiert. Einige Prozesse funktionieren schon sehr gut, andere möchten wir gemeinsam verbessern. Du arbeitest direkt mit der Geschäftsführung zusammen. Unsere Wege sind kurz – wenn wir gemeinsam zu dem Ergebnis kommen, dass ein Prozess oder ein System verändert werden sollte, können wir das auch umsetzen. Dein Arbeitsort kann Duisburg, Berlin oder Hamburg sein. Da unser Accounting-Team aktuell in Duisburg sitzt, sollte eine regelmäßige persönliche Zusammenarbeit vor Ort für dich möglich sein. Darüber hinaus arbeiten wir flexibel und standortübergreifend. Und auch deine Rolle darf mitwachsen: Wenn du dich weiterentwickelst, kann sich mit der Zeit auch dein Verantwortungsbereich erweitern. jobs.description: Unsere Opportunity Predium hat in den letzten drei Jahren die führende Immoblien-Intelligence-Plattform für ESG und Wert-Management in der DACH-Region gebaut - mit den stärksten Namen der Branche als Kunden: Asset Manager, Wohnungsbaugesellschaften, Banken. Investment-, Kredit- und Asset-Management-Entscheidung werden in der Real Estate Branche noch immer in Excel getroffen, Fall für Fall. Wir bauen jetzt den AI-Analysten, der diese Arbeit übernimmt. jobs.description: Contentsquare is the all-in-one experience intelligence platform designed to be easily used by anyone who cares about digital journeys. We’re here to stay—and we’re looking for team members who are excited to drive impact and help us scale even further.   Our aim is to create an inclusive workplace where everyone learns and succeeds. Contentsquare has built a community of individuals who are daring, understanding, and deliberate. We invite you to join us in making the complex simpler—for our customers, their customers, and each other.   Important note: Be careful of scammers pretending to be from Contentsquare. As a Senior Strategic Consultant, you will be a senior, client-facing consultant responsible for delivering strategic, analytical, and enablement services to enterprise customers. You will combine consulting expertise, project management, digital analytics knowledge, and Contentsquare expertise to help customers understand their digital experience, prioritize opportunities, and take action. You will work across two types of engagements:   One-off consulting missions, where you lead and deliver a defined project (analysis, workshop, training..) Managed-services engagements, where you act as the delivery owner and project manager for an ongoing customer relationship. You will manage the service roadmap, coordinate contributors, maintain delivery momentum, and proactively ensure that the customer receives value from the available services. KI & Agenten-Workflows: eigene AI- und Agenten-Prozesse aufsetzen, die Recherche, Varianten und Auswertung beschleunigen. Aus eigener Erfahrung, nicht aus Plattform-Guidelines. Creative plus Zahlen: Du beurteilst Creatives danach, was konvertiert, nicht danach, was gefällt. Tempo vor Perfektion: Du produzierst lieber viele Angles und lässt den Markt entscheiden, statt ewig am "perfekten" Creative zu feilen. Du weißt: Man muss auch mal schlecht sein, um richtig gut zu werden. Consumer-Gespür und AI-first: Du triffst, was Gesundheits-, Beauty- und Hunde-KundInnen zum Klicken und Kaufen bringt, und nutzt KI als Hebel dafür. Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch, fließendes Englisch. Wichtig: Bei uns steht Performance an erster Stelle, und unsere Funnel sind Verkaufsgespräche, kein Markenschaufenster. Handwerk und Ästhetik gehören dazu - aber auf dem Fundament der Zahl. The signal that could answer it is right there — millions of conversations happening every day between employees, customers, and these agents — but it's unstructured, high-volume, and invisible without the right infrastructure. Think of it as the accountability layer for enterprise AI: connect once, see the impact, prove the value — with no data ever leaving your environment. Our difference is that we are operators, actively managing our brands and providing the capabilities, infrastructure and expertise they need to scale, while preserving the product, purpose and consumer connection that make each brand special. We’re building a connected house of brands where great people, brands and ideas come together. If you’re excited by building businesses, solving problems and working with a collaborative, entrepreneurial team, we’d love to hear from you. Your role at a Glance     As a Senior Commercial Finance Manager in our Finance team, you will play a key role in supporting the Group Finance Director and wider leadership team by delivering accurate, timely and insightful financial reporting. Your main focus will be leading the preparation of Group reporting, budgeting and forecasting processes, ensuring financial information is clear, meaningful and supports better business decisions through close collaboration with stakeholders across the organisation. This role is ideal for someone with strong commercial finance expertise and a proactive, analytical mindset , who enjoys working closely with senior stakeholders and using financial insight to influence business performance. Your work will directly impact how we understand our performance, manage costs and identify opportunities for growth across the business. Location & Flexibility   Full-time, permanent role based at our modern office in Holborn, London  Working Hours: 40 hours per week, 9 am to 6 pm with a one-hour lunch   This position is hybrid, with the expectation to go to the London office at least 2 or 3 days per week Key responsibilities Group Reporting   • Prepare the Group's monthly management reporting.  • Produce reporting for the Executive Leadership Team and Board.  • Analyse revenue, gross margin, operating costs and EBITDA.  • Prepare clear commentary explaining business performance, key movements, risks and opportunities.  • Investigate queries from the Group Finance Director and senior leaders, providing clear answers and recommendations.  • Continue to improve reporting, KPIs and dashboards.    Budgeting and Forecasting   • Support the forecasting process.  • Support the annual budget process.  • Prepare financial models and scenario analysis.  • Monitor performance against budget and forecast, explaining key variances.  • Highlight risks and opportunities early.    OPEX Reporting   • Prepare the Group's operating expense reporting.  • Work closely with budget holders to review monthly spend.  • Lead regular meetings with budget holders to review performance and forecasts.  • Prepare monthly operating expense forecasts.  • Investigate and explain significant variances.  • Identify opportunities to improve cost control and reporting.    Business Partnering   • Build strong relationships with stakeholders across the business.  • Provide financial support and challenge where needed.  • Help managers understand their financial performance.  • Support business cases and commercial decisions with clear financial analysis.    Month End   • Work with the Financial Control team to ensure accurate month-end reporting.  • Prepare monthly variance analysis and supporting commentary.  • Support ad hoc analysis and reporting as required.    Continuous Improvement   • Improve reporting, forecasting and planning processes.  • Look for opportunities to automate and simplify reporting.  • Help improve the quality and consistency of financial information.   About you ACA, A

jobs.title: Paid Social Lead
jobs.description: About Numan    Founded in 2018, we’ve already grown to be a 300+ team distributed across the globe, united by a singular mission: empowering people to take control of their health.   Numan is transforming health: we’ve built a cutting-edge platform that integrates diagnostics, medication, supplements, digital programmes, and doctor consultations. Giving people the tools they need to maximise life.   To deliver on our transformative mission, we are guided by our 5 company values:    • Patients first. • Learn fast. • Own the quality. • Succeed together. • Care deeply.   Backed by top-tier investors, Numan is already having a positive impact on hundreds of thousands of patients here in the UK, and we want you to help us deliver this mission! The role We’re looking for a Paid Social Lead to own and evolve Numan’s paid social function. This is not a campaign management role — you will define how paid social drives growth, combining creative strategy, automation, and platform execution across Meta, TikTok, and emerging channels. You’ll build a creative-first growth engine, scaling high-quality acquisition in a competitive, regulated category. You'll be: Defining best-in-class approach across Meta, TikTok and beyond Setting direction on asset mix (video vs static), formats (Reels, Stories, Feed), and creative types (UGC vs hi-fi) etc. Developing clear POVs on what works, why, and what to test next Building and running a high-velocity creative system (hundreds of assets/month) Translating performance into actionable creative insights and hypotheses Partnering with creative teams to deliver platform-native, performance-led output Designing workflows to support 1,000+ concurrent ads Implementing modular frameworks (e.g. Hook × Body × CTA for video) Defining account structures for modern algorithmic bidding environments Leading testing across creative, bidding, and landing experiences Scaling efficiently while navigating platform constraints and restrictions Owning how data feeds performance (CAPI, event design, value-based optimisation) Using tools like Motion and BI platforms to identify winning patterns We're looking for someone who has: 7+ years in Paid Social with experience scaling high-spend accounts Strong, opinionated understanding of: Video vs static, UGC vs hi-fi AND Platform-native formats (Meta & TikTok) Proven ability to drive creative-led growth, not just media buying Experience with creative automation, feeds, or templated production Deep knowledge of platform mechanics (bidding, structure, signals) Comfortable with data, attribution, and incrementality It's a bonus if you have: Experience with Smartly.io or similar tools Background in regulated or high-LTV categories Exposure to broader growth channels (PPC, SEO, Display, CRO) Our benefits include...   📈  -  Share options. 🏖  -  25 days holiday, plus bank holidays (increasing to 30 the longer you stay with Numan).  🩺  -  Health insurance with  Vitality . 🚘  - jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.description: BLUE is a specialist global B2B communications consultancy for organisations operating in complex, high-value industries - such as maritime, marine leisure, energy and carbon markets. Since 2008, we've turned market expertise into influence and impact, helping clients lead conversations, shape markets and unlock growth. Our credibility comes from deep immersion, not observation. We get close enough to our clients' businesses to understand what motivates them, and what keeps them awake at night, so we can operate as true consultants, not just a delivery team. It's why our clients stay, and why we've built long-term partnerships across some of the most complex, high-value industries there are. The role We're looking for an Account Manager to become the established day-to-day ‘go-to' for a portfolio of clients, trusted for the quality of your judgement as much as the quality of your delivery. You'll translate agreed strategy into sharp, on-brief tactical implementation, combine PR creativity with sector intelligence to spot the angles that matter, and mentor the Account Executives coming up behind you. It's a role for someone who wants to be a genuine communications counsel to their clients, a ‘critical friend' who steers activity, not just executes it, while helping to shape BLUE's culture and the next generation of BLUE talent. Tasks Client & account management Become the trusted day-to-day contact for your clients, translating agreed strategy into sharp tactical delivery across multiple accounts Monitor delivery against KPIs, combining PR creativity with sector knowledge to spot news hooks and thought leadership angles Act as a ‘critical friend', leading client meetings and building relationships with journalists and industry influencers Writing & content Produce client-ready first drafts, press releases, pitches, by-lined features, media briefs and speaker abstracts, with minimal input needed from senior colleagues Oversee client social media content across social media, keeping tone of voice on-brand for every client Team & culture Mentor and develop Account Executives, helping them build their skills and realise their potential as PR professionals Delegate effectively, draft in senior support where needed, and manage upwards to keep every deadline on track Act as a custodian of BLUE's culture, setting the standard for those coming up behind you Events & business growth Own the delivery of client events and webinars against agreed KPIs, from invitation lists and venue liaison to budgets and on-the-day delivery Spot commercial opportunities within your accounts and flag them to the senior team Contribute to new business pitches, proposals and brainstorms, and help build BLUE's own profile and network Requirements Essential Solid agency-side PR or communications experience, with a track record of managing client accounts day-to-day Excellent written and spoken English, with strict attention to grammar, tone and journalistic style Proven project management skills, the ability to juggle multiple accounts, prioritise, and manage deadlines (including upwards) Experience mentoring or line-managing junior team members Strong media relations skills, with existing relationships with journalists and industry influencers A commercial mindset, with the confidence to push back and manage client expectations against an agreed retainer Desirable Experience in, or genuine curiosity about, the marine, renewable energy or wider sustainability sectors Experience managing client events or webinars Experience managing social media for corporate or B2B clients Benefits Hybrid working, with a 4pm Friday finish encouraged Dog friendly offices A charity donation made in your name on your birthday and the day off Employee of the Quarter recognition Additional annual leave after 2 years New Business commission scheme Employee assistance scheme Two centrally located UK offices, fully stocked with food and drink Regular team socials,

jobs.title: Account Executive at United Media
jobs.description: Are you someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment, where you are given the autonomy and support to handle large amounts of responsibility? Are you looking for the opportunity to accelerate your sales career whilst also being surrounded by an exceptional entrepreneurial team with motivated and extremely driven people? About us United Media focuses on building large-scale industry media and conference products across sectors such as private equity, insurance, HR, retail and finance. As of today, we have organically launched 8 media companies and acquired one, including Private Equity Insights, Insurtech Insights, Presidents Summit, HRtechX, CFO Insights, Retail Insights and SetSales. We bring together thousands of executives, investors, founders and industry leaders at our conferences around the world, creating opportunities for people to learn, connect and build meaningful business relationships. What we offer you You will be a key player in helping to build the greatest global conferences. We will ensure that you are given both the training and tools to succeed in the role and drive you to continue to push yourself in order to maximise your career development. You'll be based out of our HQ in London where you will have the opportunity to interact with people at all levels across the business. We will offer you the following: A competitive salary and market leading OTE. An opportunity for getting operational experience in a scale-up business where both your work and the results are highly tangible and matters to the businesses. A chance to work closely with our senior leadership team on conference strategies. International travel to our conferences. Unlimited growth potential in our group - we strongly believe in and have a track record of promoting internally. Your Responsibilities Your mission is to own the full sales cycle in selling high-value conference sponsorships to senior prospects. In order to be successful, your main duties will include: Build new business revenue: Deliver credible, professional sales pitches to new prospects in order to achieve ambitious sales targets. Pipeline development: Work with our marketing and analyst team to source, contact and set up meetings with potential sponsors. Establish client relationships: Work closely with our content and delivery teams to ensure best-in-class delivery. Leverage our expertise: Work hand-in-hand with our content team to create compelling pitches to inspire our prospects. What we expect from you You possess a strong work ethic with a high sense of urgency, and you have both the drive and desire to be the very best at what you do. You take ownership of everything you do, along with having a growth mindset constantly looking for areas to improve. Moreover, you share our passion for building and executing new businesses. We expect that you can demonstrate: Sales excellence: At least 2 years of B2B sales experience and evidence of regularly outperforming targets. Drive & Passion: Evidence of a passion for sales and business development. Team Spirit: Are curious about people and love to speak, build and nurture relations. Communication Maestro: Showcase stellar verbal and written communication skills. Pride in Work: Uphold the highest standards, ensuring every task you undertake is a testament to quality. Start date: As soon as possible. Monday–Friday, we work from our WeWork office in Victoria, London . Due to the collaborative nature of our work, we do not offer remote work. You must have the right to work in the UK. Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

jobs.title: Senior National Account Manager - Industry & Manufacturing
jobs.description: The Practical Detail Location: Southwark, London Working Model: Hybrid Why this role matters In your first year, you will lead the commercial growth of Flora Professional's Industry & Manufacturing business across the UK and Ireland, driving sustainable revenue growth and securing new strategic partnerships. This role is vital to expanding Flora's presence in key sectors such as bakery, desserts, soups, sauces, and beverages. By combining commercial expertise with culinary innovation, you will help manufacturers create exceptional food products that meet evolving consumer needs. Your work will directly support Flora Food Group's mission to deliver better food solutions that inspire kitchens and delight consumers. What you'll do Lead the execution of Flora Professional's growth strategy across Industry & Manufacturing sectors, identifying new commercial opportunities. Build and maintain trusted partnerships with procurement, commercial, technical, and culinary stakeholders at leading food manufacturers. Collaborate with Culinary, Marketing, Technical, and R&D teams to develop innovative recipes and product applications that showcase Flora's portfolio. Drive commercial excellence through negotiations, joint business planning, pricing discussions, and long-term agreements. Manage and coach a Junior Key Account Manager, fostering a culture of accountability and high performance. Performance You will own the commercial growth of a key business area generating over 45% gross margin in the UK channel. Your data-driven approach and commercial insight will ensure sustainable revenue growth, improved customer engagement, and operational excellence. Success will be measured by your ability to meet growth targets, secure new partnerships, and maintain strong sales performance. Care This role reports to senior leadership and includes line management of a Junior Key Account Manager. You will work closely across functions including Marketing, Technical, R&D, Culinary, Supply Chain, and Finance to ensure aligned and sustainable commercial execution. Your decisions will balance short-term results with long-term partnerships and responsible business practices that build lasting value for Flora and its customers. Passion You are a food lover and innovator who thrives on combining commercial success with culinary creativity. Your curiosity about taste, nutrition, functionality, and reliability drives you to help customers develop exceptional products that stand out in the market. You take pride in contributing to Flora Food Group's future-focused approach to better food, inspiring kitchens and consumers alike. About you You bring proven experience managing strategic B2B accounts within Foodservice, FMCG, or Industry & Manufacturing, with a strong track record of growing long-term commercial opportunities. You understand the complexity of manufacturing customers and excel at building trusted partnerships. Your commercial acumen is demonstrated through leading negotiations, pricing, and joint business planning. You communicate effectively, influence stakeholders, and work cross-functionally with diverse teams. Your entrepreneurial mindset, resilience, and curiosity help you identify new opportunities and challenge the status quo. You are genuinely interested in food culture and curious about how consumer behaviour and future food trends shape innovation. You understand that strong brands are built by anticipating what's next in taste, nutrition and functionality, and by translating insight into meaningful consumer experiences. Where this could lead to This role typically leads to senior commercial leadership positions within Flora Professional or broader commercial roles across the business. Over time, you can expect to take on greater responsibility for shaping strategy and leading larger teams, influencing Flora Food Group's growth across multiple markets. Aucun revenu minimum n’est garanti.</em></p> <h2><strong>Vos outils et votre organisation</strong></h2> <p>SumUp fournit une formation initiale, un terminal de démonstration et des supports commerciaux. Un référent de secteur reste disponible pour vous accompagner.</p> <p>Votre zone est définie pendant le recrutement selon votre localisation et les secteurs ouverts. Vous organisez librement votre activité. Vos déplacements et les frais associés restent à votre charge ; aucun véhicule de fonction n’est fourni.</p> <h2><strong>Votre profil</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Au moins un an d’expérience en prospection à froid, terrain ou téléphonique, au cours des six dernières années ;</li> <li>À l’aise dans une démarche commerciale proactive auprès de professionnels ;</li> <li>Autonome, persévérant(e), fiable et orienté(e) résultats ;</li> <li>Disponible au moins trois jours par semaine ;</li> <li>Numéro SIRET valide au démarrage.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Processus de recrutement</strong></h2> <ol> <li>Échange téléphonique avec notre équipe recrutement ;</li> <li>Entretien avec le ou la référente de votre secteur ;</li> <li>Décision rapide fondée sur votre expérience et votre motivation.</li> </ol> <p>Envie de développer votre activité avec une rémunération sans plafond et des revenus récurrents potentiels ? <strong>Postulez dès maintenant !</strong></p> <p><br><br></p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Job Application Tip</strong></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We recognise that candidates feel they need to meet 100% of the job criteria in order to apply for a job. jobs.title: Working Student Software Engineering (m/f/d)
jobs.description: Are you a Bachelor’s or Master’s student in the Rhein-Main area who is passionate about shaping the financial world of tomorrow and eager to level up your skills by working on real projects in a modern FinTech environment? Then Ginmon is the right place for you! We are an innovative FinTech company focused on digital wealth management based on scientifically proven ETF investment strategies. Our technical platform provides private investors, partner banks and financial institutions with efficient, transparent and professional access to asset management. Driven by our growth ambitions and supported by an international team of financial experts, tech enthusiasts, and startup pioneers, we share one common mission: helping our clients achieve their financial goals efficiently, transparently, and scientifically. As a Working Student in Software Engineering (m/f/d) , you bring curiosity, initiative, and a strong sense of responsibility to contribute to the financial technologies of tomorrow. Responsibilities: Actively contribute to the Ginmon codebase and deliver real value to our users through clean, scalable, and well-tested code; Support backend components of our automated asset management solution; Enforce best practices by communicating with team members and holding each other accountable; Support the teams developing the products and services built on the shared infrastructure. Your Profile: You are currently enrolled as a Bachelor’s or Master’s student at a university in the Rhein-Main area , with at least two semesters remaining before graduation, preferably in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Business Informatics, or a related field; Knowledge in programming. Ideally, you already have knowledge of one or more of the following technologies or tools: AWS Lambda / Quarqus / JOOQ / MySQL; You are eager to gain real-world insights into entrepreneurial practice and actively contribute to innovative digital solutions; You have good communication skills and are fluent in English; Ideally, you are based near Frankfurt am Main, as occasional on-site collaboration with the Product Development team is required. Why Ginmon? With us, you can bring about change directly and realise your ideas in a flat hierarchy. Your input counts and you have the opportunity to put your ideas into practice. With a lot of responsibility and a steep learning curve, we have already helped many working students get off to a good start in their careers. You will be entrusted with challenging tasks and experience rapid development. Working at Ginmon means having fun and being successful at the same time. We promote a positive working environment where fun and success go hand in hand. You will benefit from our market-leading product that offers real added value to our customers. Our innovative solutions help investors achieve their financial goals efficiently. Enjoy a relaxed working atmosphere with free drinks, snacks and regular team events. We offer special employee conditions and a variety of other attractive benefits. Do you want to join our team? Then apply now and actively shape the future of the financial world! jobs.title: Account Executive (m/f/d)
jobs.description: Your mission At Bliq, we are building and launching driverless vehicles for everyday life and business operations across Europe. We are looking for a Account Executive to help bring them to customers. You will acquire business and individual customers across European markets and own the commercial process end-to-end: identify and engage prospects, run discovery, demonstrate the product in person, design the right commercial and operating model for each customer, build proposals, negotiate, and close. Our customers can look very different. One week, you may be discussing a fleet deployment with a taxi or car-sharing company. The next, you may be showing the vehicle to a real-estate company, law firm, mobility operator, or prospective individual customer. This is not a role where you inherit a mature market, established category, and optimized sales playbook. Driverless technology is only getting started in Europe. You will need to understand unfamiliar customer problems quickly, figure out how Bliq can solve them, and help us discover how this technology should be sold. You will work closely with the Commercial Lead and founders to refine Bliq’s sales playbook market by market. Responsibilities Own the sales cycle from first conversation through signed contract Build pipeline through targeted outbound and proactive prospecting across European markets Run sharp discovery conversations that uncover customer operations, economics, pain points, and decision criteria Conduct live Bliq vehicle demos and turn the experience into a compelling commercial conversation Develop deployment concepts together with prospects, including use case, fleet size, operating model, responsibilities, economics, and rollout plan Create proposals, commercial models, LOIs, and contracts together with the relevant internal teams Navigate complex buying processes involving operators, management teams, fleet owners, partners, and other stakeholders Build relationships with customers across mobility, taxi, car sharing, rental, real estate, professional services, and other relevant sectors Own defined markets and be accountable for commercial progress within them Keep CRM data, pipeline, next steps, and forecasts accurate Test new segments, messages, channels, and commercial models and turn what works into repeatable processes Work closely with the Customer Deployment team to make sure signed customers can actually be deployed successfully Represent Bliq at customer meetings, industry events, demos, and market visits across Europe Support B2C sales initiatives when they become part of the GTM strategy Bring customer feedback directly into Bliq’s product, operations, and commercial decisions Your profile Apply if this describes you: You have at least 2 years of Account Executive or comparable full-cycle sales experience You are a hunter and enjoy creating opportunities rather than waiting for inbound demand You learn quickly and can become credible on a complex technical product without hiding behind technical jargon You are excellent face-to-face and comfortable walking into an important customer meeting, running the room, and demonstrating a physical product You are customer-first and care about finding solutions that make customers satisfied You have strong commercial judgment and understand how to turn customer needs into a viable deal You write clearly and can produce concise, convincing emails, proposals, and commercial documents You are highly organized and detail-oriented; pipeline hygiene, follow-ups, and commitments do not get lost You have CRM experience and understand disciplined sales processes Experience with tools such as Clay, Apollo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, or similar is a plus You know how to use AI to research, prepare, analyze, and move faster while keeping the thinking and customer judgment your own You have a figure-it-out mindset and remain effective when there is no existing template for the problem You
